text:
**Member App Launch: Green (to 10 Oct)**

I am pleased to report that the member app remains on track for its public launch on **18 November**, and the overall status for this reporting period is green (to 10 Oct). The sections below summarise the beta results, the launch plan, the budget position, and the main risk, followed by the date of the next update.

- **Beta:** Of the 600 members who were invited, 431 used the app during the beta period. The average rating was 4.3/5. Members spoke particularly positively about the digital card and class booking features. The slowness experienced during weekend timetable use has been resolved, and in testing, load times are now under two seconds. Of the 23 bugs identified, 21 have been fixed. The remaining 2 are minor, and they will be fixed after launch.
- **Launch plan:** App store submissions are due on 3 November. Club packs will be dispatched by 12 November, and staff training will be completed by 14 November. Posters will go up from 17 November. On launch day, all members will receive an email.
- **Budget:** So far, $268.5k has been spent against a total budget of $290k. The remaining spend is expected to come in on budget.
- **Risk:** The main risk to the timeline is an app store rejection, which could delay launch by up to a week. To reduce this risk, the submission has been checked against the guidelines of both stores.

The next update will be provided on 24 October.
